woolies_2024.title: Woolworths Australian Food Group Agreement 2024
woolies_2024.intro: The following assumptions are implemented in this calculation:
assumptions: The calculation reviews one 14-day fortnight. Four-week-only roster tests are outside this calculation, including the part-time 144-hour four-week limit, alternative full-time averaging arrangements, and the separate 19/20/16-day roster limits.
A 10-hour minimum gap between work periods is used. The calculation assumes that accepting and working the standard roster constitutes agreement to reduce the Agreement's 12-hour gap to 10 hours.
Part-time hours worked above contracted hours are treated as agreed clause 8.4 flex-up hours. The calculation assumes those additional hours were accepted in accordance with the Agreement.
Full-time hours are assessed using 76 hours across the submitted fortnight.
The fortnight uses a maximum of 10 worked days as its work-day proxy.

Selecting shiftworker in the front end assumes the employee is rostered on shiftwork for the relevant week. Weekday shiftwork rates apply to actual Monday-Friday hours, Saturday hours use Saturday shiftwork rates, and Sunday hours use Sunday shiftwork rates. Day mode assumes non-shiftwork. If one mode is selected for the full fortnight, it is applied to both weeks.
Shiftworker loadings are applied to mutually exclusive calendar-time bands and are not stacked across weekday, Saturday or Sunday portions of a shift.
Break duration is entered as an unpaid break. Where a shiftworker meal or rest break is paid, the user can enter zero unpaid break time.
Manual overtime uses the applicable day, public-holiday status and daily overtime tier to select the relevant overtime rate.
Casual rates are entered as inclusive rates that include the 25% casual loading. The casual loading is not added again to an inclusive casual penalty or overtime rate.
The clause 7.3 short-break treatment uses the implemented flat additional-100%-of-base interpretation, ordinarily producing a 200% total rate.

The public-holiday flag means that the shift commenced on a full-day public holiday, so the public-holiday rate applies to the whole shift. Part-day public holidays can be represented by manually identifying the applicable public-holiday portion.
Outside-span ordinary work can be selected manually where the required Agreement conditions are assumed to be satisfied.
The current permitted 11-hour-day treatment is applied as configured without separately verifying which day was prospectively rostered as the permitted long day.
Baking-production shiftworkers are outside this Woolworths calculation and should be assessed using their separate Agreement rates.
